checks.identity: exact repository/name/index/job/run/source; completed failing job required
checks.job_terminal_independent_of_run_terminal: Intentional: job completed/failure suffices; other original jobs may still be running. No source/result reuse authorized.
checks.no_artifact: complete nonduplicated API inventory required; eligibility only, no fake log/steps/exitcode.
checks.missing_log: only actual gh exit1+exact404 JSON/AzureXML response retained byte-for-byte; auth/server/other errors propagate. Revalidation rehashes and reparses raw404 proof.
checks.collection: API detail equals inventory; ZIPsize/digest API exact; bounded path-safe in-memory ZIP inspection; candidate list pinned; complete raw with successful baseline; exit1+exact last guard; no source seal.
checks.fresh_execution: original archive kept solely in controller inspection directory; source checkout9a and existing runner/attest/finish unchanged.
checks.outcomes: Missed/Timeout preserved; no old raw becomes source seal; final seal requires new fresh complete raw/live-source proof.
checks.workflow: only description/comments differ, original runner flags/tool/source checkout/uploads unchanged.
checks.existing_test_ast_nodes: all7 unchanged; two new independent test classes; no removed old assertion.

limitations: Review is read-only; no independent Cargo, mutation, model, dispatch or full Python test execution. Author tests/preflight are identified separately.

Authorization artifacts are reproducible evidence, not signatures. Future collection must authenticate recovery API run/attempt/controller/artifactZIP and fresh seal, ensuring one result perindex before the unchanged64-way quality gate.
Missing logs cannot supply an original exitcode or original candidate identity; those fields remain absent/unknown.
No old raw/classification is rehabilitated and no quality approval is asserted.
